name: popsicle
headline: Post Advisor AI: Social Media Content Optimizer
short_description: PostAdvisor AI is a full-stack web application that helps creators and marketing teams design higher-engagement social media content using AI, platform-specific best practices, and data-driven insights.
author: Hanene2004

sections.overview:
Post Advisor AI is a full-stack web application designed for content creators and marketing teams to optimize social media posts across multiple platforms. It provides AI-driven content creation tools including a Full Advisor for detailed guidance, Hook Generator for attention-grabbing openers, Post Rewriter for content improvement, and Tone Transformer for stylistic variations. The platform integrates platform-specific best practices for Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and Twitter/X, while offering smart analytics to track engagement trends and manage draft content. With built-in performance prediction and actionable insights, users can make data-driven decisions to increase post engagement.
Social media managers optimizing content strategy across multiple platforms
Content creators generating high-engagement posts with AI-powered hooks and rewrites
Marketing teams analyzing predicted performance and comparing post variations
Individual creators tracking engagement trends and managing draft content libraries
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/Hanene2004/post-pal-ai`
sections.usage:
```
Act as PostAdvisor AI. I'm a [ROLE] at [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] industry. I need help creating a [PLATFORM] post about [TOPIC]. My target audience is [AUDIENCE]. Generate a post with the following details: [DETAILS].
```
